meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you based the zero on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Turn the screen so I can read that history myself. People write in other places and paste it in, Hale, so what else do you have?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Give me the scene. A wrong quotation is a mistake, Hale, and seventeen-year-olds make them at midnight. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays quiet, so tell me where it sits right now.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Okay, Hale. Owen will do it Thursday at 8:15 to put this behind him, and only if it's in your room with no other students there. I want the arrangement in an email tonight, including your written promise that nothing goes on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you agreed that Owen will do a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, and that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require that arrangement in writing, including your promise that nothing goes on his record and that no other students will be present. I expect that email from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to the supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 to put this behind Owen, and she still wants the arrangement and a promise that nothing goes on his record in writing tonight, with no other students in the room.
What moved her: "612 words arrive in one edit", because it was exact, timed, tied to Owen's own document and something she could check herself.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked where things sit on his record right now, answer that directly before offering the rewrite, so she doesn't leave with that question open.
